repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: card thread · 2026-11-21T06:07Z · one PR for #35883 and #35884 (`Fixes #35883`, `Fixes #35884`)
Area: b1-M
Session: `session_01L6bhgXQEtN6Kp1wRKH6Fde` (the card thread, building itself under the dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-jdeh3j
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (phone toolbar row, panel entries), `plugin-list/src/conditions/*` (sort and filter content reused), `plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` and `components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (view and view-settings panels in a new container), new `plugin-list/src/phone/*` (near-full-screen bottom panel plus the ✓ staging layer); `ui/packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx` (touch reorder); `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx` and `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (phone top row: back, object name, more); plugin-grid phone cards (long press enters selection); the i18n packs; a changeset.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (provisional; measured on the built declarations, and the claim is amended if it reads yes)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: re-read on main `b113178d` (with #35918) by the card thread: holds.
Basis: cards #35883 and #35884, p2 children of epic #35880, which the maintainer handed to this seat on 2026-11-20 16:41Z; one PR by the agreed grouping (7045034149).
Scope: the phone top row; one row of chips with counts; the sort, filter, view and view-settings panels as near-full-screen bottom panels where × discards and ✓ applies (a staging layer over the same apply as desktop); touch reorder in the sort builder; a read-only note for advanced filters; the keyboard does not cover inputs. Two seat calls on shared paths: (1) the Save control and its menu (save to this view, save as my view, discard; naming, toast) belong to #35955; this PR draws the host's existing `conditionRowEnd` slot at the right of the phone row, so the phone gets #35955's control when it lands, and #35955 is asked for a compact face. (2) The selection action bar belongs to #35678; this PR adds only the ways in (long press on a card, More → Select), the card check mark and hiding "+" while selecting, and uses the current selection surface until #35678 replaces it.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #35678 and #35955 run in parallel threads on overlapping files (`ListView.tsx`, the page header); `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push and whoever lands second merges. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.
